FAPI plan proposals are distinguished from historical community accounts and are not represented as delivered or evaluated interventions.

executive_assessment.text: Chaco water constraints differ from eastern-region conditions; Indigenous community accounts around Irala Fernández identify storage and emergency-delivery gaps. Bañados adds a distinct urban flood-livelihood case.

Water-service competition and weak local grievance/institutional capacity are relevant mediators, but retrieved sources do not establish climate-caused violent conflict. Proposed community water and fire measures are not verified implementation.
